contract: Byte-identical encoded stream and exact decoded original; retain CRCs, errors, full consumption and API behavior.
job: Compress and decompress complete natural files at block-size settings 1 and 9; decode complete text archives in small-memory mode.
measurement_boundary: One protected native batch executes each distinct original codec operation once. Process startup, file I/O, allocation, checksums, finalization and flushed output are timed; container startup, input staging and host verification are excluded. A separate small-text-batch executes each of its complete text decodes once (75 public, 65 held-out); both units use one candidate codec build.
name: bzip2
operations: Streaming BZ2_bzCompress / BZ2_bzDecompress, fresh state per object, fixed 64 KiB I/O chunks
Complete text archive BZ2_bzDecompress, small=1, block size 9, 64 KiB I/O
timing: Shared shim native process-start-to-exit protocol; no resident stop or result-export exclusion.
title: Compress and decompress natural files with bzip2
readme_notes: Each original public and held-out performance operation runs exactly once in one protected native process; the original individual operations and guards remain mandatory correctness-only cases. Native process startup, file I/O, allocation, CRCs, finalization and output flush are timed; input staging and authentication are not. Process startup may not exceed 2% of a unit. The small-text-batch unit decodes 75 public (65 held-out) complete block-9 text streams with small=1, grouped separately from the original batch and using the same codec build.
